claim: In the matching retail DLL, Audience.PlayLoopCheerVoice (0x060047DA) is an instance method with exact signature blob 2002010802, parameters nLevel:Int32 and force_play:Boolean, and an exact 276-byte body. After the standard MatchMain/Fade/unsigned-frame-mod-20 suppression gate, it clamps nLevel to raw 1..4, computes raw localLevel = nLevel + CheerLevel_Total + 3, initializes Float32 low/high to 0.3f/1.0f, and compares AttendanceRate with raw 0.0f using bne.un. Only ordered equality takes the zero-volume path; unequal or unordered values take the emitted arithmetic path low = low - (1.0f - AttendanceRate) * 0.1f and high = high - (1.0f - AttendanceRate) * 0.5f. It then computes volume = low + (high - low) * (Float32(localLevel) / 11.0f) and multiplies by raw 1.0f. The raw loop sound ID starts at 40, becomes 39 when CheerLevel_Total <= 1, and becomes 41 when CheerLevel_Total >= 4. If force_play is true or that ID differs from seid_LoopCheerVoice, it calls Menu_SoundManager.Play_CheerVoice_Loop(id,volume) and stores the ID; otherwise it calls Menu_SoundManager.SetVol_CheerVoice_Loop(volume). FACT-0079 pins one direct caller at Audience.TensionDown IL+0x002C with raw arguments 0 and false.
